info.name: ViCollab Contribution Scoring
info.description: Test cases TC-01 to TC-14 for POST /api/contributions/score and GET /api/health. Start the server with npm start first.

item.name: TC-01 Balanced team: 3 members, 2 commits and 100 lines each

exec: pm.test('every member scores 33.3', () => pm.response.json().members.forEach(m => pm.expect(m).to.include({ commits: 2, linesChanged: 100, commitShare: 33.3, linesShare: 33.3, score: 33.3 })));

request.description:
Balanced team: 3 members, 2 commits and 100 lines each

Expected: 200. Aarav, Meera, Kabir each: commits 2, linesChanged 100, commitShare 33.3, linesShare 33.3, score 33.3. warnings [], errors []

item.name: TC-02 One dominant member (Aarav 6 of 10 commits, 700 of 1000 lines)

exec: pm.test('one dominance warning about Aarav', () => { const w = pm.response.json().warnings; pm.expect(w).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(w[0]).to.include('Aarav'); });

request.description:
One dominant member (Aarav 6 of 10 commits, 700 of 1000 lines)

Expected: 200. Aarav 60 / 70 / score 64.0; Meera 20 / 20 / 20.0; Kabir 20 / 10 / 16.0. One warning that Aarav is above 60%

exec: pm.test('Isha scores 100', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().members).to.eql([{ author: 'Isha', commits: 3, linesChanged: 100, commitShare: 100, linesShare: 100, score: 100 }]));
pm.test('no warnings for a one-person team', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().warnings).to.eql([]));

request.description:
Single-member team (Isha only)

Expected: 200. Isha: commits 3, linesChanged 100, 100 / 100 / score 100. No dominance warning because the team has 1 member

item.name: TC-04 Listed member with zero commits (Isha)

exec: pm.test('Isha listed with zeros', () => pm.expect(m.Isha).to.include({ commits: 0, linesChanged: 0, score: 0 }));

request.description:
Listed member with zero commits (Isha)

Expected: 200. Aarav 50 / 60 / 54.0; Meera 25 / 20 / 23.0; Kabir 25 / 20 / 23.0; Isha 0 / 0 / 0. Warning "Isha has 0 valid commits"

exec: pm.test('each member 1 commit, score 50', () => pm.response.json().members.forEach(m => pm.expect(m).to.include({ commits: 1, linesChanged: 50, score: 50 })));

request.description:
Duplicate sha (g001 sent 3 times)

Expected: 200. g001 counted once: Aarav 1 commit / 50 lines, Meera 1 / 50, both 50 / 50 / 50.0. skipped.duplicates = 2

item.name: TC-06 Merge commits ignored ("Mergesort ..." is a normal commit)

exec: pm.test('scores 32 / 32 / 36', () => { pm.expect(m.Aarav.score).to.equal(32); pm.expect(m.Meera.score).to.equal(32); pm.expect(m.Kabir).to.include({ commits: 1, linesChanged: 40, score: 36 }); });

request.description:
Merge commits ignored ("Mergesort ..." is a normal commit)

Expected: 200. skipped.merges = 2. Aarav 1 / 30 lines / 32.0; Meera 1 / 30 / 32.0; Kabir 1 / 40 / 36.0 (commitShare 33.3 each)

item.name: TC-07 Invalid commits mixed with valid ones (missing author, negative additions, bad date, additions as text)

exec: pm.test('4 errors at index 2-5', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors.map(e => e.index)).to.eql([2, 3, 4, 5]));

request.description:
Invalid commits mixed with valid ones (missing author, negative additions, bad date, additions as text)

Expected: 200, no crash. errors has 4 entries (index 2 missing author, 3 additions, 4 invalid date, 5 additions). Aarav 50 / 40 / 46.0; Meera 50 / 60 / 54.0

item.name: TC-08 Date filter since 2026-03-01, until 2026-03-15 (until day is inclusive)

exec: pm.test('Meera commit on the until day is kept', () => pm.expect(m.Meera.commits).to.equal(1));
pm.test('Kabir has 0 and a warning', () => { pm.expect(m.Kabir.commits).to.equal(0); pm.expect(pm.response.json().warnings).to.eql(['Kabir has 0 valid commits']); });

request.description:
Date filter since 2026-03-01, until 2026-03-15 (until day is inclusive)

Expected: 200. skipped.outsideDateRange = 2. Aarav 1 / 50 / 50.0; Meera 1 / 50 / 50.0 (commit at 18:30 on the 15th is kept); Kabir 0 with a 0-commits warning

exec: pm.test('clear message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.equal('"commits" must be a non-empty array of commit objects'));

request.description:

Expected: 400 { error: "\"commits\" must be a non-empty array of commit objects" }

exec: pm.test('JSON error, not an HTML page', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ error: 'Request body is not valid JSON' }));

request.description:
Malformed request body (truncated JSON)

Expected: 400 { error: "Request body is not valid JSON" } returned as JSON, server keeps running

Score exactly 60% (limit is "above 60")

Expected: 200. Aarav 60 / 60 / score 60.0; Meera 40 / 40 / 40.0. No dominance warning (60.0 is not above 60)

item.name: TC-13 Only empty commits (0 lines changed in total)

exec: pm.test('linesShare 0, score 30, no NaN', () => pm.response.json().members.forEach(m => pm.expect(m).to.include({ commits: 2, linesChanged: 0, commitShare: 50, linesShare: 0, score: 30 })));

request.description:

Health check
